result.summary: Do not ship yet: a concrete numeric-host bypass defeats the new metadata-address block. All 56 validator tests pass but miss this case.

findings.title: Numeric IPv4 notation bypasses the metadata SSRF block
findings.body: InstanceConfig(url="http://2852039166", enabled=True) succeeds. The helper at triggarr/web/validation.py:150-173 treats this numeric host as an arbitrary hostname after ipaddress rejects it. Verified that HTTPX preserves the host and socket.getaddrinfo with AI_NUMERICHOST resolves it to 169.254.169.254 without DNS. Startup passes the accepted URL into the client at triggarr/startup.py:153-160, permitting requests to the metadata address this new check explicitly intends to block. This is a concrete bypass, independent of the documented DNS-rebinding exception.
findings.recommendation: Reject noncanonical numeric IPv4 hosts or normalize them before applying the blocked-address checks. Add model-level regression tests for decimal, hexadecimal, and shortened IPv4 representations of blocked addresses.

next_steps: Close the numeric-host bypass and rerun validator and configuration tests. Configuration tests could not run with default capture under the read-only sandbox.
